ordered_dispositions.disposition: Accept: generated typed evidence URLs each receive a separate budgeted line up to512 scalars, protected36-line/3200scalars explicit new human decision. PR/head links are separate.
Accept: OperatorDoc restores the no-forge approve-bead --doc operator lookup pointer, owner-bound to real digest; no invented URL or terminal consent.
Accept: protected36-line budget permits full multi-line effects and wrapped mandatory prose; remaining unrenderable valid asks have explicit intact-owner Marmot recovery and human disclosure.
Accept: source warnings coalesce across all selected workstreams/collections, capped at three summary lines for four sources; per-row unknown/count facts retained.

Accept explicit new bounded-display decision: maximal complete-row prefix within19pages, final20th part states actual shown/total plus Marmot owner lookup. No implied cursor or narrower nonexistent command.

Accept: ordinary missing required source ->Unavailable; protected missing/unavailable->Withheld(required-source), existing stale/unknown/future->Withheld(stale-approval). Missing protected pairs->Withheld(missing-required).
Accept: closed collection enum now covers ready/parked/held/deferred/needs-human/launches/pause plus all five digest collections.
Accept: exact whole command vocabulary is excluded only from path heuristic, including final fixed terminal notices; nested slash/dot paths remain screened.
Accept: SafeText uses literal screened plain text, no punctuation backslash escaping or assumed Markdown rendering; copyable labels remain literal.
Accept: exhaustion notices have explicit workstream and role; blocked notices explicit workstream,Nbeads,Mapprovals.
Accept: current question reactions are ignored(question-reaction-unsupported), approval reaction during suspension is ignored(trust-suspended). No reaction maps to a choice.
Accept: suspension holds approval decisions only; ordinary workstream intake/task steering/questions retain classification, preserving governing ADR.
Accept: command candidate detection uses fixed Unicode White_Space table; non-ASCII-whitespace-prefixed slash yields InvalidCommand instead of intake.

Accept: all seven explicit human decisions enumerate label-vs-private-path, candidate-order, UTC, wsd multipart and bounded overflow changes alongside original sequencing/protected/identifier changes.
Accept: protected question Withheld has fixed question wording and no answer recorded; approval retains CannotApprove wording.
Accept: render rejects protected kinds; only atomic render_card_pair can produce protected workstream/control texts.
Accept: ordinary data and FYI time footers explicit; Notice variant text only, Reminder one line, Digest pagination no generic footer; protected no time footer.
Accept: warning constant uses exact U+26A0 U+FE0F sequence.
Accept: older586 object explicitly historical superseded, a27 sole current governing ADR17; both native approval snapshots pinned and external repo resolution supplied.
Accept: header safe labels wrap before separate atomic mention line, all total limits rechecked; no partial pair success.
Accept: canonical question instruction exactly Reply with a choice label. in all references.
Accept: validate supplied ascending approval order, never sort; opaque order key canonical lowercasehex string decodes boundedbytes.
Accept: unknown state uses emdash rather than needs-operator questionmark; unknown is not operator action request.
Accept: at most two complete packing passes based on marker digit width, deterministic final n<=20.
Accept: eventual human ask must explain all decisions/material residuals on-card with links as evidence, never rely solely on opening the design.
